🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +6.86% | 1M: -1.36%) RECOVERY and SPY (1W: -1.08% | 1M: +1.02%) CORRECTION plus HYG (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +0.57%) ABOVE TREND provide the twin confirmations of mixed/flat signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Duration demand and commodity strength are the drivers: TLT (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND signals bond bid while XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +14.20%) ABOVE TREND show energy-led cyclicality; VXX RECOVERY warns of episodic volatility.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: Dollar and yield curve flagged NEUTRAL in the desk barometer, while TLT (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND implies lower yields; HYG (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +0.57%) ABOVE TREND signals modest credit support.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and commodities leading: XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND, XLI (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND and XBI (1W: +1.68% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND. Tech weak: XLK (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND — style mixed (cyclicals > growth for now).

5. US vs Global?
US taking a pause: SPY (1W: -1.08% | 1M: +1.02%) CORRECTION. EM/EU mixed: EEM (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +6.51%) CORRECTION, FXI (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND — China lagging.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Selective risk appetite: ARKK (1W: +1.93% | 1M: -8.82%) RECOVERY but IBIT (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.77%) CORRECTION show constrained speculation.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Bifurcated: Oil/Brent strong — USO (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +12.98%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +14.20%) ABOVE TREND — while copper CPER (1W: -3.42% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND and precious metals GLD (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION show rotation within commodities.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy coherent strength: XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND while natural gas UNG (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -4.61%) BELOW TREND — favor oil-linked exposure over gas.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: TLT (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND and energy ETFs (XLE, BNO) ABOVE TREND confirm duration/commodity bid; DIVERGENCE: XLK (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND plus multiple 1W/1M mismatches (XLB, EWJ, GLD) indicate rotational noise.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor duration and energy exposure given TLT (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to tech XLK (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND and China FXI (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND while monitoring VXX (1W: +6.86% | 1M: -1.36%) RECOVERY.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND, Industrials XLI (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND, Biotech XBI (1W: +1.68% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND, Materials XME (1W: -5.25% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, Financials (sector 1W: -1.59% | 1M: -0.59%) showing weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Brent BNO (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +14.20%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +12.98%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper CPER (1W: -3.42% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND and Natural Gas UNG (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -4.61%) BELOW TREND; precious metals SLV (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -16.84%) BELOW TREND remain under pressure.

13. Key Levels?
Watch VXX ~20 (volatility complacency pivot), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit-health threshold), XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, with mixed confirmations from VXX (RECOVERY) and SPY (CORRECTION). Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND) and duration (TLT ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength while Tech (XLK BELOW TREND) and several 1W/1M divergences (XLB, EWJ, GLD) are key risks to monitor.
